turns.text: What is the most I would have to pay in a really bad year?
That is the stop-loss. It caps your out-of-pocket co-insurance at S$6,000 in a policy year, as long as you are with a panel provider or it is an emergency. It does not include the deductible.
And the deductible sits outside that cap.
Sorry, what is the most I would have to pay in a really bad year?
